decisions.reason: The supplied build recipe compiles the old four-argument call against a six-argument declaration. This is a source-level build failure, independent of fuzz input.
decisions.finite_witness: Run the supplied build recipe through its programs/fuzz build step with the default configuration; compilation of fuzz_privkey.c reaches line 22.

scope_contract.reason: Private-key parsing is the entry's primary operation, and its changed signature governs that call.

feasible_trigger.reason: The recipe builds this fuzz program with the default configuration, which enables the guarded parser call. No particular input bytes are needed for a compile-time failure.

evidence.dependency_reason: The default configuration enables the parser guard.

observable_consequence.reason: The call has four arguments; the changed declaration requires six, preventing compilation.

alternatives_ruled_out.reason: The complete entry contains one parser call, and the recipe's fallback build uses the same source. Inputs cannot alter argument count.

identity_preserved.reason: Each check concerns compilation of this entry's mbedtls_pk_parse_key call under the supplied recipe.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: The changed definition confirms the six-argument signature.

harness_evidence.dependency_reason: The recipe reaches compilation of the fuzz program.

scope.summary: The build blocker is independently confirmed. The retained evidence identifies the parser signature and several unrelated program changes; it does not support an independent classification of every other selected group, so whole-scope sufficiency is unresolved.

lifecycle.reason: The entry initializes and frees the PK context around the parser call.
